identity.description: A Windows endpoint executes a malicious payload that mimics Linux behavior by initiating network communication to a rare external host, triggering an ABIOC for uncommon process communication. Cortex should detect this anomaly in process start and network activity.

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Uncommon Windows Process Communication
biocs.description: Detection of rare Windows process communicating with external host
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'wget' and action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.10'

abiocs.name: Windows Process Communicating to Rare External Host
abiocs.description: Detection of unusual Windows process initiating communication to a rare external IP address
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.10' and actor_process_image_name = 'wget'

xql_queries.name: Detect Rare External Host Communication
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.10'
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'wget'
